[SWS_LinTrcv_00147] ⌈The function LinTrcv_SetOpMode shall switch the internal
state of channel LinNetwork to the value of LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_NORMAL if
one of the following conditions is fulfilled:
a) the channel LinNetwork is in mode LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_SLEEP
b) the channel LinNetwork is in mode LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_STANDBY and the
optional transition from this mode to LINTRCV_TRCV_MODE_NORMAL is enabled.⌋
